decisions.reason: After two years on the market, this cooler remains close to the firm's core thermal equipment business, and accumulated investment plus visible commitment make withdrawal within the next year unlikely.

This condenser fits the firm's stated direction toward efficient heat-exchange solutions, so management is likely to continue supporting it and interpret any mixed performance as temporary rather than abandon it.
Because it is highly similar to the established portfolio and has already remained in the market through 2024, escalation of commitment favors retaining it rather than reversing course now.
The tube liner builds on the firm's service and repair capabilities and installed customer base, which strengthens justification for keeping it available despite any limited early uptake.
As a customized product line with several models and strong relevance to core industrial customers, it represents a broad and visible commitment that management is especially likely to sustain.
These repair inserts support the firm's lifecycle-service model and existing heat-exchanger base, so prior development effort and customer-service logic both favor keeping them on the market.
